headline: Chaldybar checkpoint to be closed to cars from November 25
summary: The Chaldybar checkpoint on the Kyrgyz-Kazakh border in Chuy region will temporarily close to vehicles from 1:00 on November 25. All types of vehicle traffic will stop passing through it.
why: Border crossings govern road freight and trade flows between Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan, which affects regional transport and logistics costs.
original_headline: КПП «Чалдыбар» закроют для автомобилей с 25 ноября
